Recipes DMEM-10% DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS, 1% penicillin/streptomycin 10,000 U/ml, and 1% 100 mM sodium pyruvate, cultured at 37°C with 5% CO 2 . Working solution of 1 mg/ml PEI Weigh the viscous liquid to get 50 mg/ml in water ( e.g ., 0.42 g PEI + 8.4 ml water) and transfer to a sterile 50 ml Falcon. Place Falcon in a water bath set to 50°C and gently pipette up and down using a 1 ml pipette until fully dissolved. Dilute to 1 mg/ml with water ( e.g. , take 0.5 ml of your 50 mg/ml stock and add 24.5 ml water) The solution in its current state will be very basic. Adjust pH to 7 using diluted hydrochloric acid. Filter through a 0.22 µm filter and aliquot into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes. Store at -20°C long-term and at 4°C for up to one month while in use.

steps.title: Maintain HEK293T producer cells
steps.instruction: Culture HEK293T cells in 25 ml DMEM‑10 % in a 75 cm² tissue‑culture flask at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Seed cells for virus production
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293T cells at 7.5 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 6‑well plate with 3 ml DMEM‑10 % per well; agitate plate with rapid up‑down, left‑right movements to distribute cells evenly; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare DNA transfection mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube add 100 µl Opti‑MEM, 0.6 µg p8.91 plasmid, 0.6 µg CSFLW plasmid, and 0.5 µg glycoprotein plasmid (SARS‑CoV‑2 S, SARS‑CoV S, VSV‑G or empty pcDNA3.1) per well; incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare PEI transfection reagent
steps.instruction: In a separate 1.5 ml tube add 100 µl Opti‑MEM and 10 µl PEI (1 µg ml⁻¹) per transfection; incubate 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Combine DNA and PEI mixes
steps.instruction: For each 100 µl DNA mix add the 100 µl PEI mix, vortex/pipette vigorously ten times; incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add transfection mix to cells
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl of the DNA‑PEI mixture dropwise to each well; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Replace media after transfection
steps.instruction: The next morning gently aspirate the transfection media without disturbing the monolayer; add 3 ml DMEM‑10 % to each well; incubate 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest first virus supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the cell supernatants, pool wells with the same transfection condition into a 50 ml Falcon tube, and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Second media replacement
steps.instruction: Add another 3 ml DMEM‑10 % to each well and incubate another 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest second virus supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the second supernatant and pool with the first‑day harvest.

steps.title: Clarify pooled supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the pooled supernatant at 2 500 × g for 10 min at 4 °C to remove cellular debris.

steps.title: Aliquot and store pseudovirus
steps.instruction: Aliquot 4–5 ml of clarified pseudovirus into 2 ml bijou tubes and freeze at –80 °C. (Larger volumes can be produced in 10 cm² dishes; adjust media volumes accordingly.)

steps.title: Seed HEK293T for ACE2 expression
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293T cells at 7.5 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 6‑well plate with 3 ml DMEM‑10 %; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; ensure 60–80 % confluency.

steps.title: Transfect ACE2 plasmid
steps.instruction: In a sterile 1.5 ml tube add 200 µl Opti‑MEM and 500 ng human ACE2 plasmid per well; bring TransIT‑X2 to room temperature, add 2 µl TransIT‑X2 per µg DNA, flick to mix, incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add ACE2 transfection mix to cells
steps.instruction: Dropwise add 200 µl of the ACE2 transfection mixture to each well; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest ACE2‑expressing cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate transfection media, add 1 ml DMEM‑10 % per well, and gently pipette to detach cells (no trypsin); transfer to a 50 ml Falcon tube and dilute to 2 × 10⁵ cells ml⁻¹ with DMEM‑10 %.

steps.title: Seed cells into 96‑well assay plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µl of the diluted cell suspension (2 × 10⁴ cells) into each well of a flat, white‑bottom 96‑well plate; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare virus dilutions
steps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot of SARS‑CoV‑2, SARS‑CoV, VSV‑G (positive) and empty vector (negative) pseudoviruses; in a clear‑bottom 96‑well plate add 100 µl undiluted virus to the top row and perform 10‑fold serial dilutions in DMEM‑10 % to a final volume of 100 µl per well.

steps.title: Infect ACE2‑expressing cells
steps.instruction: Remove media from the 96‑well plate containing ACE2‑transfected cells and add 100 µl of each virus dilution; incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Measure luciferase activity
steps.instruction: Aspirate media, add 50 µl Bright‑Glo reagent diluted 1:1 with serum‑free, phenol‑red‑free DMEM; incubate 5 min in the dark and read luminescence on a GloMax Multi+ (0.5 s integration).

steps.title: Export and plot data
steps.instruction: Save the CSV file from the GloMax to a USB flash drive, analyse in Microsoft Excel and plot using GraphPad Prism.

steps.title: Maintain BHK‑21 cells
steps.instruction: Culture BHK‑21 cells in 25 ml DMEM‑10 % in a 75 cm² flask at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Seed BHK‑21 for receptor screen
steps.instruction: Seed BHK‑21 cells at 1 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 24‑well plate with DMEM‑10 %; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; ensure 60–80 % confluency.

steps.title: Transfect ACE2 constructs in BHK‑21
steps.instruction: In 100 µl Opti‑MEM add 500 ng of each species‑specific ACE2 construct or empty pDISPLAY vector; bring TransIT‑X2 to room temperature, add 3 µl per µg DNA, flick, incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add transfection mix to BHK‑21
steps.instruction: Dropwise add 100 µl of the transfection mixture to each well; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest transfected BHK‑21 cells
steps.instruction: Remove media and add 0.5 ml 2 mM EDTA in PBS per well to detach cells; transfer to a bijou tube and dilute to 2 × 10⁵ cells ml⁻¹ with DMEM‑10 %.

steps.title: Seed BHK‑21 into 96‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µl of the diluted cell suspension (2 × 10⁴ cells) into each well of a flat, white‑bottom 96‑well plate; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Infect BHK‑21 with pseudovirus
steps.instruction: Add SARS‑CoV‑2 or SARS‑CoV pseudovirus (equivalent to 1 × 10⁶–1 × 10⁷ RLU) or no‑GP control to each well; incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Luciferase readout for BHK‑21
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl Bright‑Glo diluted 1:1 with serum‑free, phenol‑red‑free DMEM; incubate 5 min in the dark and read luminescence as above; export CSV and plot.

steps.title: Seed HEK293T for neutralisation assay
steps.instruction: Seed HEK293T cells at 7.5 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 6‑well plate with 3 ml DMEM‑10 %; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; ensure 60–80 % confluency.

steps.title: Transfect ACE2 for neutralisation
steps.instruction: In a sterile 1.5 ml tube add 200 µl Opti‑MEM and 500 ng human ACE2 plasmid per well; bring TransIT‑X2 to room temperature, add 2 µl per µg DNA, flick, incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add ACE2 transfection mix
steps.instruction: Dropwise add 200 µl of the ACE2 transfection mixture to each well; incubate overnight at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare serum/antibody dilutions
steps.instruction: Create the desired dilution series (e.g., 2‑fold starting at 1:10) in serum‑free DMEM; for a 1:10 start use 10 µl serum + 90 µl medium per well (final volume 100 µl).

steps.title: Dispense dilutions into assay plate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µl of each diluted serum/monoclonal antibody/inhibitor in triplicate to the top row of a flat, white‑bottom 96‑well plate; add 50 µl serum‑free DMEM to all other wells.

steps.title: Perform serial 2‑fold titration
steps.instruction: Remove 50 µl from the top row and transfer to the next well, mixing well; repeat to achieve a 2‑fold dilution series down the plate, leaving the bottom row as untreated control.

steps.title: Add pseudovirus to neutralisation plate
steps.instruction: Thaw pseudovirus aliquots, dilute in serum‑free DMEM to ~1 × 10⁶ RLU, add 50 µl to each well (including untreated controls); incubate 1 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Harvest ACE2‑expressing cells for assay
steps.instruction: Aspirate media from the 6‑well plates used for ACE2 transfection, add 1 ml DMEM‑10 % per well, and gently pipette to detach cells; transfer to a 50 ml Falcon tube and dilute to 2 × 10⁵ cells ml⁻¹ with DMEM‑10 %.

steps.title: Seed cells onto neutralisation wells
steps.instruction: Dispense 100 µl of the diluted cell suspension (2 × 10⁴ cells) into each well containing serum/antibody plus pseudovirus and into untreated control wells; incubate 48 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Luciferase readout for neutralisation
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl Bright‑Glo diluted 1:1 with serum‑free, phenol‑red‑free DMEM; incubate 5 min in the dark and read luminescence on a GloMax Multi+ (0.5 s integration). Export CSV and plot data.

steps.title: Prepare DMEM‑10 % medium
steps.instruction: Supplement DMEM with 10 % fetal bovine serum, 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin (10 000 U ml⁻¹), and 1 % 100 mM sodium pyruvate; store at 4 °C and use at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Make 1 mg ml⁻¹ PEI working solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.42 g PEI and add 8.4 ml deionised water to obtain a 50 mg ml⁻¹ stock; dissolve by placing the tube in a 50 °C water bath and pipetting up‑and‑down with a 1 ml pipette until clear; dilute 0.5 ml of this stock with 24.5 ml water to reach 1 mg ml⁻¹; adjust pH to 7.0 with diluted hydrochloric acid; filter through a 0.22 µm membrane; aliquot into 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes and store at –20 °C long‑term and at 4 °C for up to one month.
